metadata.scope: Explicitly selected native result cohort, retrospective. Not an all-history completion rate; all historical attempts are separately reconciled.

cost.accounting_basis: Original selected-invocation native reference prices; not account billing or cumulative case cost.
limitations: Retail estimates exclude credits, free tiers, volume discounts and tax.
Unobserved services are not inferred; partial subtotals are not totals.
Repair is a subset. Oracle runs are not allocated to planner versions.
